verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
We lift our voices
We lift our hands
We lift our lives up to you
We are an offering
Lord, use our voices
Lord, use our hands
Lord, use our lives, they are yours
We are an offering

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
All that we have, all that we are
All that we hope to be
We give to you
We give to you
